segments.name: Device Solutions
products: standard electricity, gas, and water meters
implementation and installation of associated devices
segments.description: Hardware products for measurement, control, or sensing sold to utilities and other global markets.
segments.evidence: Device Solutions – This segment primarily includes hardware products used for measurement, control, or sensing.

segments.name: Networked Solutions
segments.description: Complete solutions combining communicating endpoints, network infrastructure, and software for acquiring and transporting application-specific data.
segments.evidence: Networked Solutions – This segment primarily includes a combination of communicating endpoints (e.g., smart meters, modules, endpoints, and sensors), network infrastructure, network design services, and associated headend management and application software designed and sold as a complete solution for acquiring and transporting robust application-specific data.

segments.name: Outcomes
segments.description: Value-added software and services using analytics to help utilities, municipalities, and cities improve decisions and operations.
segments.evidence: Outcomes – This segment primarily includes our value-added, enhanced software and services in which we utilize distributed compute to manage, organize, analyze, and interpret raw, anonymized data using artificial intelligence, machine learning, statistical modeling, and other analytics.

segments.name: Resiliency Solutions
segments.description: Software and services for worker safety, emergency preparedness, and damage prevention for critical infrastructure providers and contractors.
segments.evidence: Resiliency Solutions – This segment primarily includes software and services focused on worker safety, emergency preparedness and response, and damage prevention for critical infrastructure providers and their supporting contractors.

revenueModel.text: Utilities and cities pay Itron for hardware, software, and services delivered as standalone one-time purchases or multi-year end-to-end solutions, including recurring SaaS, NaaS, and managed services.
revenueModel.evidence: These solutions may be delivered as part of a standalone, one-time purchase or an end-to-end solution spanning multiple years.

changes.text: In 2025, Itron added Resiliency Solutions as a new reportable segment in the fourth quarter, following its acquisition of Urbint, Inc.
changes.evidence: Resiliency Solutions is a new reportable segment starting in the fourth quarter of 2025.
